item.title: ‘Batman: Arkham VR’ Sequel Cancelled Amid Meta XR Studio Closures
item.description: Meta’s recent rash of studio closures means that the planned sequel to Batman: Arkham Shadow has also officially been cancelled. Batman: Arkham Shadow (2024) was developed by Camouflaj, released exclusively on Quest 3 in late 2024, coming just one week after the launch of Meta’s $300 Quest 3S. item.title: Google’s Leading AR Glasses Partner XREAL Files Patent Lawsuit Against VITURE
item.description: AR glasses maker XREAL has filed a patent infringement lawsuit in the United States against affiliates of VITURE, its direct competitor.
